items:
Summary:

Highlights:

5 Bed, 4 Bath, Sleeps 13

6-Seater Golf Cart with Every Reservation

3 Min Walk to Pool!

8 Min Walk to Beach!

24/7 Professional Management with Safe, Keyless, Contact-Free Check-in



The Space:

Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 13):

- Guest Bedroom I, First Floor: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Master Suite I, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Master Suite II, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Guest Bedroom II, Second Floor: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

- Bunk Room, Second Floor: Two (2) Sets of Twin-over-Twin Bunks with 1 Pull Out Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo



Reasons to Book Your Happy Place in Seagrove Beach on 30A Today:

- 5 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms, Accommodates 13

- 6-Seater, Street-Legal Golf Cart with Each Reservation

- Perfect for Families and Young Guests

- Propane Grill w/ Complimentary Propane Provided

- Full-Size Washer/Dryer

- 2 Patio/Porches with Seating

- Fully Appointed Kitchen

- Dining Room Table with Seating for 7

- Breakfast Bar with Seating for 4

- Full Size Refrigerator With Ice Maker

- Full Size Gas Stove With Oven

- Granite Countertops

- Pots, Pans, & Cooking Utensils Provided

- Blender, Toaster, Dishes & Eating Utensils Provided

- Complimentary Wireless Internet

- Full-Size Washer & Dryer

- Standard (drip-style) and K-Cup (Hybrid) Coffee Machine

- Professional Resort Linens and Towels Provided (Excludes Beach Towels)

- Snowbird-Friendly Monthly Rates (November through February)

- Short (~3 min) Walk to the Community Pool!

- Short (~8 min) Walk to the Beach!



Relaxation and adventure await at Your Happy Place at Seagrove Beach on 30A; boasting 2,358 square feet and offering accommodations for up to 13 guests in 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. This quaint hideaway offers the best of the gulf coast, less than a mile from lake Eastern Lake and a secluded Beach Access.



The perfect place for a peaceful family getaway, Your Happy Place in Seagrove Beach on 30A will surely be a go-to vacation destination for the family for years to come! On the first floor, you'll find an open-plan living space with 10 foot ceilings, ideal for entertaining the whole family.  Hang out on the front porch in the morning, or just chill on the back patio.



The Kitchen is fully-equipped and offers plenty of space for preparing Family Dinners!  Plenty of room around the Dining Room Table (seats 6-7) or the Breakfast Bar (seats 4) to accommodate the whole clan comfortably.



The living room is the heart of the home, with plentiful room on the couch to sit around flat-screen TV on those balmy Florida nights.  After a day at the beach, gather the family around for a Family Night!



Guest Access:

Beach & Pool Access:

- Beach Access:  Beach access for Your Happy Place in Seagrove Beach is the Walton Dunes Beach Access on the Beachfront Trail on the east side of Eastern Lake, approximately 0.4 miles (or an 8 minute walk) from the home.

- Pool Access: Your Happy Place is right down the road (about 120 feet!) from the Cottages at Eastern Lake Community pool, only a three minute walk!



Parking & Getting Around:

- Golf Cart: 6-Seater Golf Cart with Every Reservation

- Parking: Parking for 2 large size SUV's in driveway.



Nearby Restaurants:

Crabby Steve's, La Cocina Mexican Grill and Bar, Acme Ice House, Wild Olives Market and Cafe, Cowgirl Kitchen, George's At Alys Beach, Caliza Restaurant, Crabby Steves, Summer Kitchen Cafe, Barbacoa Mexican Grill, Donut Hole, Freshii, Roselie Dining and more!



The Neighborhood:

Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. The coastal villages of Seaside, Grayton, and WaterColor lie within a mile or two to the West, while Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and WaterSound lie a few miles East. 30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful gulf coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country’s most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.



Other Things to Note:

LSV/Golf Cart: 6-Seater Golf Cart provided to the Guest. Rental policy applies to all reservations.



Age Requirement: Please note our age requirement policy for March/April: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 must be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.



Two Night Reservations: Please note, two (2) night reservations are subject to a lower max occupancy. A two-night reservation max sleeping capacity is equal to half of the standard max occupancy restriction for the property.



Promotions, Rates, Availability, Closures, Construction, and Cancellations:

Promotions may change, be cancelled, and dates may be blacked out at BeachWalk's sole discretion and without notice.

Rates, availability, and minimum stay requirements are subject to change without notice.

Please check Walton/Okaloosa County local news outlets for up-to-date information on closures or construction that may affect your vacation. BeachWalk is not responsible for any disruptions caused by nearby construction or closures of community amenities, such as pools or other shared facilities, as these are managed by the respective Homeowners' Associations and may impact your overall experience. Rental Agreement applies to all reservations.

Cancellation or changes to the dates of stay within a certain period prior to check-in may result in forfeiture of payment or associated fees, depending on the timing of the request.



No Pets: No pets of any kind are permitted. Violating this policy will incur an additional $500 charge, plus the cost of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



No Smoking or Vaping: Smoking in any form (e.g., cigarettes, cigars, “e-cigarettes” or “vapes”) is not permitted. Violating this policy will incur an additional $500 charge, plus the cost of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



Interaction with Guests:

Questions?

Contact us by responding to our Confirmation/Welcome Message.

Confirmation will be emailed and/or texted upon booking.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
